title: The Most Stolen Trucks in America (One Is Stolen 10x More Than Average)
description:
The most stolen trucks in America, by count, by risk per truck and by parts: NICB's 2025 list, the HLDI theft study, catalytic converters, tailgates, the hotspots and what actually stops thieves. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:55 The most stolen by count
5:59 The most stolen by risk
8:31 Why thieves want trucks
9:48 Catalytic converters and tailgates
12:07 Where trucks are stolen
15:46 What actually stops thieves
18:48 How not to buy a stolen truck
19:48 The verdict

Sources:
- NICB via The Auto Channel, U.S. vehicle thefts experience historic decline (Mar 18, 2026): https://www.theautochannel.com/news/2026/03/18/1646167-u-s-vehicle-thefts-experience-historic-decline.html
- AutoGuide, America's top 10 most stolen cars: https://www.autoguide.com/auto/s-america-s-top-10-most-stolen-cars-44631280
- The Shop, NICB: U.S. vehicle thefts down: https://theshopmag.com/news/nicb-us-vehicle-thefts-down-as-prevention-partnerships-pay-dividends/
- AmericanTrucks, America car theft hotspots 2026: https://www.americantrucks.com/america-car-theft-hotspots-2026.html
- Associated Press via News4JAX, Ford's tech to thwart F-150 thieves (Dec 12, 2025): https://www.news4jax.com/business/2025/12/12/ford-turns-to-stepped-up-tech-and-cooperation-with-police-to-thwart-f-150-pickup-thieves/
- GM Authority, GMC Sierra among most stolen vehicles (HLDI study, Aug 2025): https://gmauthority.com/blog/2025/08/gmc-sierra-among-most-stolen-vehicles-in-the-u-s/
- ABC7, Costa Mesa tailgate thefts: https://abc7.com/post/costa-mesa-police-seeing-spike-thieves-stealing-tailgates/15003606/
- Digital Dealer, Carfax top 10 vehicles targeted for catalytic converter theft (June 2026): https://digitaldealer.com/news/carfax-top-10-vehicles-targeted-by-recent-catalytic-converters-thefts/171369/
- Compustar, modern ways thieves are stealing cars: https://www.compustar.com/blog/new-threats-on-the-road-3-modern-ways-thieves-are-stealing-cars/

Photos from Wikimedia Commons, full credits and licenses: https://github.com/viniciushoscher-ctrl/american-trucks/blob/main/agendamento/creditos/video30.md
